title: Babana sabır

characters.FATHER: a father in his thirties with thick black hair and a black mustache, wearing a navy blue knitted sweater
characters.TODDLER: his son, a toddler of about one with chubby cheeks, wearing a little red jumpsuit
characters.OLDDAD: the same father, now in his seventies with white hair and a white mustache, wearing a navy blue knitted sweater and reading glasses
characters.MAN: his grown son, a man of about thirty-five with short black hair, wearing a grey hoodie

scenes.text:
Babana bir şeyi ikinci kez anlatırken
sesin değişiyor, değil mi?
scenes.prompt: In a cozy living room on a rainy evening, {OLDDAD} sits on a sofa looking hopeful, a smartphone lying on the coffee table in front of him, while {MAN} sits on the right with a tired, impatient face, looking away. Warm lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Oysa o sana yürümeyi öğretirken
düşüşlerini hiç saymadı.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny autumn garden, {FATHER} kneels on the grass with open arms as {TODDLER} takes wobbly first steps toward him, golden leaves falling from the trees.

scenes.text:
Her düştüğünde eğildi,
iç çekmeden yeniden kaldırdı.
scenes.prompt: In the autumn garden, {TODDLER} sits on the grass after a small fall, and {FATHER} bends down with a patient smile to lift him up, leaves drifting in the wind.

scenes.text:
O tuşu sorması bahane;
istediği seninle beş dakika daha.
scenes.prompt: {OLDDAD} sits on the sofa looking warmly at {MAN} instead of at the phone on the table, a soft smile under his white mustache, lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Bir dahakine yavaş anlat.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On a garden bench under a big autumn tree at sunset, {OLDDAD} on the left and {MAN} on the right sit close together laughing, golden leaves falling around them.

caption:
Babana sabrın yetiyor mu?

O sana hiç saymadan sabretti. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
